formula: There is no guarantee that + subject + verb

formulas.formula: There is no guarantee that + subject + verb

example: There is no guarantee that lower prices will increase demand.
exampleZh: 降低價格並不能保證需求會增加。

examples.en: There is no guarantee that lower prices will increase demand.
examples.zh: 降低價格並不能保證需求會增加。
examples.highlight: There is no guarantee that lower prices will increase demand.

rules.zh: 核心句型只是：【There is no guarantee that + clause】 在【that】後面必須接一個完整子句：【that + subject + verb】 正確：【There is no guarantee that the plan will succeed.】 錯誤：【There is no guarantee that the plan’s success.】 錯誤：【There is no guarantee that succeeding.】
rules.en: There is no guarantee that + clause that + subject + verb There is no guarantee that the plan will succeed. There is no guarantee that the plan’s success. There is no guarantee that succeeding.

rules.zh: 句型不表示結果一定不會發生意思是球隊未必會勝出，而不是球隊一定會落敗。比較：【There is no guarantee that the team will win.】 不能保證球隊會勝出。 球隊肯定不會勝出。 兩句的意思完全不同。
rules.en: There is no guarantee that the team will win. The team is guaranteed not to win.

rules.zh: 在本練習中不可省略日常英語有時會省略 that：【There is no guarantee prices will fall.】 但為了讓句型結構清楚，本練習統一保留 that：【There is no guarantee that prices will fall.】
rules.en: that There is no guarantee prices will fall. There is no guarantee that prices will fall.

rules.zh: 目標表達【be】可以按照時間改變現在：【There is no guarantee that the plan will work.】 不能保證這個計劃會奏效。 過去：【There was no guarantee that the plan would work.】 當時不能保證這個計劃會奏效。 較一般或較正式的說法：【There can be no guarantee that the plan will work.】 無法保證這個計劃會奏效。 這些是時態或語氣上的變化。核心概念仍然是：【there + be + no guarantee that + clause】
rules.en: be There is no guarantee that the plan will work. There was no guarantee that the plan would work. There can be no guarantee that the plan will work. there + be + no guarantee that + clause

rules.zh: 子句的動詞要符合時間和意思將來結果：【There is no guarantee that demand will increase.】 能力或可能性：【There is no guarantee that everyone can attend.】 現在情況：【There is no guarantee that the information is accurate.】 過去角度：【There was no guarantee that the passengers would arrive on time.】
rules.en: that There is no guarantee that demand will increase. There is no guarantee that everyone can attend. There is no guarantee that the information is accurate. There was no guarantee that the passengers would arrive on time.

rules.zh: 以下部分是可選擴展，不是固定句型的一部分第 A 項：放在句首；第 B 項：接在 but 後面；第 C 項：接在條件句後面；第 D 項：放在報告動詞後面；第 E 項：加入 still；以上句子使用不同的文法外殼，但真正需要學習的核心句型仍然是：【There is no guarantee that + clause】
rules.en: There is no guarantee that the treatment will work. The treatment may help, but there is no guarantee that it will work. Even if the patient follows the instructions, there is no guarantee that the treatment will work. Doctors warn that there is no guarantee that the treatment will work. There is still no guarantee that the treatment will work. There is no guarantee that + clause

rules.zh: 有關聯的文法可以保留，但不屬於核心句型以下都是文法正確的相關表達：【There is no guarantee of success.】 但本練習的指定答案必須包含：【there + be + no guarantee that + clause】
rules.en: There is no guarantee of success. Success is not guaranteed. A high salary is no guarantee of job satisfaction. The company cannot guarantee that sales will rise. there + be + no guarantee that + clause

rules.zh: 固定形式必須使用 There is no guarantee that + 完整子句；不可寫成 there has、there is not guarantee，亦不可省略 that 後的正確動詞形式。核心句式可單獨使用，也可接在 but、even if、although 或報告動詞後，並可按語境改成 there was、there can be 或加入 still；這些引導子句、連接詞和副詞都是可選延伸。
rules.en: There has no guarantee that prices will fall. There is no guarantee that prices will fall. There is not guarantee that prices will fall. There is no guarantee prices will falling. 1. There is no guarantee that + clause. 2. Subject + may / can + verb, but there is no guarantee that + clause. 3. Even if + clause, there is no guarantee that + clause. 4. Although + clause, there is no guarantee that + clause. 5. Subject + reporting verb + that there is no guarantee that + clause. 6. There was no guarantee that + past-viewpoint clause. 7. There can be no guarantee that + clause. 8. There is still no guarantee that + clause. The introductory clause, reporting verb, but-clause and adverb are optional extensions. They are not compulsory parts of the fixed expression.

benefits.zh: 準確表達「有可能，但不確定」這個句型可以清楚區分「可能發生」和「一定發生」。這句只說明需求可能增加。這句進一步提醒讀者，降低價格並不能確保需求一定增加。
benefits.en: Lower prices may increase demand. There is no guarantee that lower prices will increase demand.

benefits.zh: 避免把推測寫成事實學生在作文和報告中有時會把可能結果說得太肯定：【More advertising will increase sales.】 除非有充分證據，這句可能過於武斷。較謹慎的說法是：【More advertising may help, but there is no guarantee that it will increase sales.】 這樣可以避免過度斷言。
benefits.en: More advertising will increase sales. More advertising may help, but there is no guarantee that it will increase sales.

benefits.zh: 有禮貌地質疑別人的假設你不需要直接說對方的想法是錯的。你可以承認某個做法可能有幫助，再指出結果仍然不確定。這種說法適合討論、會議和議論文。
benefits.en: Hiring more staff may help, but there is no guarantee that it will solve the problem.

benefits.zh: 清楚連接行動和不確定的結果這個句型可以把兩項意思連接起來：某個行動已經完成或可能完成；但預期結果未必會出現。讀者可以立即看出「減價」不一定會帶來「需求增加」。
benefits.en: The company reduced its prices, but there is no guarantee that demand will rise.

benefits.zh: 適合正式分析這個句型常用於：議論文；商業報告；市場分析；科學討論；政策評論；工作會議；風險評估。它能讓說話者或作者保持客觀和謹慎。
benefits.en: This structure suits formal analysis in argumentative writing, business reports, market and scientific analysis, policy commentary, meetings and risk assessments. It keeps the writer's claim objective and cautious.

benefits.zh: 增加句式變化這個句型不必每次放在句首。你可以寫：【There is no guarantee that the plan will work.】 這些變化可以避免所有句子都使用相同開首。
benefits.en: There is no guarantee that the plan will work. The plan may help, but there is no guarantee that it will work. Even if we follow the plan carefully, there is no guarantee that it will work. Experts warn that there is no guarantee that the plan will work.
